Loss report: argo -> gitlab
[lost] pipeline/ci display.name (GitLab CI has no display name here; the name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci pipeline.env (secret API_TOKEN is written as the variable $API_TOKEN; a GitLab file cannot mark it as a secret)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.env (secret DEPLOY_KEY is written as the variable $DEPLOY_KEY; a GitLab file cannot mark it as a secret)
